art_direction: 真希扎着深绿色马尾、戴眼镜，穿高领毛衣在安静图书馆翻书。
composition_variation: Create a crisp contemporary anime portrait of Maki Zenin browsing a quiet library. Preserve her dark green ponytail, rectangular glasses, clear determined eyes, and composed youthful presence. Dress her in a fully covering olive high-neck sweater, dark straight-leg trousers, and low shoes. She sits at a narrow reading table, turning one page of an open plain book with a simple natural gesture. Use dark walnut shelves, parchment cream pages, jade chair upholstery, narrow afternoon highlights, and an uncluttered softly shaded upper wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
